summary: Iteration 34 — frontend-only retest of the 2 remaining 'Nouvelle demande' modal issues from iteration_33 (Marcus SIMÉO, localStorage ms_employee_id=emp-marcus-simeo, /rh/demandes). RESULT: 1 of 2 fixed. (a) HEIGHT STABILITY = STILL FAILING: rAF sampling over 1.5s, 3/3 opens, the form paints at 634px and jumps to 760px at t≈260-360ms (delta 126px) when GET /api/availability resolves. The min-h-[520px] wrapper is simply too short: measured wrapper height after load is 646px (calendar itself 622px, cal-grid 387px), so the 520px reservation is exceeded by 126px — exactly the observed jump. The vertical SHIFT is fixed though (form top stays at y=32 the whole time thanks to items-start), so the flash is now a downward growth only, no re-centering. (b) SHORT-VIEWPORT TOP = FIXED: on 1366x700 the form top is y=32 (>=0), 'Nouvelle demande' overline at y=53 and the X close button at y=53 are both visible without any scrolling; internal form scroll works (scrollTop 0, scrollHeight 758 / clientHeight 666) and the X button is clickable and closes the modal cleanly (0 residual dialogs). ADDITIONAL finding: month navigation also re-flows the modal (760px for a 6-row month like Août 2026 -> 694px for a 5-row month like Septembre 2026), so the jump is not only a load-time issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Post-mount growth flash NOT fixed: min-h-[520px] under-reserves. Measured timeline (3/3 opens): t=83ms wrapper 520px / cal 235px / grid 0px -> t=99ms grid 80px -> t=261ms wrapper 646px / cal 622px / grid 387px; form height 634 -> 760 (+126px). Fix properly INSIDE LeaveCalendar: render 42 placeholder cells (or min-h on [data-testid='cal-grid'] equal to 6 rows: 6*cell + 5*6px gap ≈ 387px) while loading, so the grid never changes height; alternatively raise the wrapper reservation to >=660px. A wrapper min-height alone cannot work because it must be >= the tallest (6-row) month.

Month navigation resizes the modal: Août 2026 (6 grid rows) => form 760px, Septembre 2026 (5 rows) => 694px. Same root cause; a fixed 6-row grid min-height fixes both the load flash and the month-nav jump.

rca_of_the_issue: The flash persists because the reserved height (min-h-[520px] on the calendar column wrapper) is smaller than the calendar's real loaded height (646px). While /api/availability is pending, the grid renders one 80px 'Chargement…' row, so the column collapses to the 520px floor; when the 6-week grid (387px) paints, the column grows to 646px and the modal grows 126px. Reserving the grid height for 6 rows inside LeaveCalendar eliminates both the load flash and the 5-row/6-row month-nav jump.
